items.ruling_applied: manual §3.1 rule 3; R3 (FDC as one agent)
items.reason: Cohort 3 is 'BMS-986504 + Nivolumab + Relatlimab FDC'; the approved FDC is the partner regimen to which the investigational BMS-986504 is added, treated like the approved chemotherapy partners (pemetrexed, carboplatin, paclitaxel, gemcitabine) that both coders coded soc_backbone; pumitamig and daraxonrasib are investigational. Moot for analysis because the trial fails S5.

items.coder_A: Solid-tumour basket; GBM is named only in keywords (not conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels), but a temozolomide + radiotherapy cohort and RANO v2 response criteria strongly imply an eligible GBM cohort. Would be basket_gbm_eligible if this were accepted.
items.reason: Conditions are 'Solid Tumors' and inclusion is 'advanced and/or metastatic solid tumor malignancy with homozygous deletion of the MTAP gene'; GBM appears only in keywords ('Brain cancer; GBM'), and the Cohort 4 label 'BMS-986504 + Temozolomide + Radiotherapy' does not name glioblastoma. C7 says keywords do not make a trial eligible even if they imply a GBM cohort.

note: Trial fails S5 (not_glioblastoma), so the candidate set does not reach the analysis. Nivolumab/relatlimab FDC as soc_backbone vs experimental_combination is not directly settled by a rule (medium). Basket proposed false because GBM is not eligible (coders split A true / B false, priority 3). tumour_pk 'unclear' per W7 (PK planned, sample type not stated).
